verdict.rationale: Database Webhooks send data to another system whenever a table event occurs, which is a direct event-to-action mechanism [supabase-docs-8]. Cron adds time-based triggers [supabase-docs-9], Realtime Postgres Changes lets clients listen to database changes [supabase-docs-18], and Edge Functions provide server-side action handlers [supabase-docs-29]. Agent skills that cover Cron and Queues give AI agents a way to set this up [supabase-probe-rt-3]. Missing for 10: documentation of conditional or filter rule definitions beyond table events, explicit Postgres trigger or event-to-function wiring docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration that webhook automation works as described.
